      Customize tool bar
      
  
      Drag rows by their dots (or use the arrows) to reorder. Click a row, then Add divider to put a divider under it. Untick to hide. Colors is the main, sub and transparent swatches. You can also drag tools straight up and down the tool bar.
      
  
      
  
      

      

      
  
      Projects and backups
      
  
      Everything autosaves in this browser about every 45 seconds, with a backup copy every 10 minutes (the last 6 are kept). Opening a backup opens a copy, so the original stays safe.

      Pen and tablet
      
  
      
  
      
  
      A browser can only read your pen through Windows Ink, which is Clip Studio's “Tablet PC” option. Wintab can't be reached from a web page, so beleaf always uses the Tablet PC route. If pressure doesn't come through, turn on Windows Ink in your tablet driver (Wacom: Wacom Tablet Properties → Mapping → “Use Windows Ink”; XP-Pen and Huion: tick “Windows Ink” in the driver), then reload. On Android and iPad the stylus works straight away.
      
  
      Draw in the box with your pen
      
  
      
    
    
    
    
    
  
      
  
      Pressure feel works like Clip Studio's “Adjust pen pressure”: left needs a lighter touch for full strength, right needs you to press harder.
      
  
      
  
      
    
      What is this? Normally your tablet talks to Windows, and Windows passes the pen to the browser (that's Windows Ink). WebHID lets beleaf talk to the tablet directly instead, so pressure can work even with Windows Ink turned off. You pick your device, your browser asks “allow beleaf to use this?”, and that's it. It's new and doesn't work with every tablet: some brands only speak their own private language. Buttons on remotes, keypads and controllers can also be set to beleaf actions here.
      
    
      
    
    
      
    
    
      
  
      
  
      

      

      
  
      Shortcut settings
      
  
      
  
      Click a Primary or Sub box, then press the key. Backspace clears it. Tools can share a key: press it again to switch between them.

      The accent colours buttons, sliders, highlights and the logo’s sparkles.
      CanvasRegular canvases
      Canvas colour
      Area around the canvas
      Every new canvas starts with this colour, unless you pick a different one when you make it. The area around the canvas stays the way you set it.
      Emote sheet canvasEmote boxes and the area around them
      Emote box colour
      Area around the canvas
      Every new emote sheet starts with this box colour (the gaps between boxes follow it), unless you pick a different one when you make it. The area around the sheet stays the way you set it.
      To change the canvas or sheet you already have open, use the colour swatch at the bottom of the Layers panel.
      ShareSend your theme to friends or load theirs
      Makes a picture card of your theme with the colours tucked inside. Friends open it with Import, or drop it on the canvas.
